contea di ritrovamento: North Lincolnshire (Inghilterra e Galles)
D/ IMP LICINIVS PF AVG ; R/ GENIO POP ROM

Copper alloy coin. Nummus of Licinius I (308-324), Genio Pop Rom issue of 307-317, probably Trier mint, Reece period 15, RIC volume 7 no. 58. Obverse description: Bust laureate cuirassed right. Obverse inscription: IMP LICINIVS PF AVG. Reverse description: Genius standing left holding patera and cornucopiae. T F in field. Reverse inscription: GENIO POP ROM. Diameter: 20mm, Weight: 2.58gms, die axis: 6
